# Error #50: SponsorInactive

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#50`
- **Variant Name**: `SponsorInactive`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SponsorInactive` — the sponsor's budget is paused (inactive).

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::paused_sponsor_blocks_relay_until_resumed`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/sponsor_test.rs::paused_sponsor_blocks_relay_until_resumed). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// SponsorInactive — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let sponsor = Address::generate(&f.env);
register_sponsor(&f, &sponsor, 10_000, 10_000);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .set_sponsor_active(&sponsor, &false);
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
Some(rejected!(sponsored_claim(&f, &sponsor, id, 1, 1, {
    f.env.ledger().timestamp() + DAY
})))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked paused_sponsor_blocks_relay_until_resumed
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Resume the sponsor budget with `set_sponsor_active(sponsor, true)` before relaying, and submit the signed claim before its `deadline`.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#13-gas-sponsorship-relayed-claims-without-a-mempool-relayer)
